# Seven Warlords of the Sea

[All quest chapters](index.md)

<a id="q-149839deb0f6a5b9"></a>

## The Government's Offer

Mihawk, Crocodile, Doflamingo, Kuma, Hancock, Moria and Jinbe: seven pirates the World Government licensed instead of hanged.

Accept a Warlord seat. Recruitment officers seek out pirates with bounties between 25,000,000 and 80,000,000, and only seven seats exist.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Sabaody Archipelago](04_summit_war.md#q-16f410ad3a59c0e0)

**Tasks**

- Hold a Warlord seat

**Rewards**

- Doriki +600, Belly +40,000, +1 Training Points (your style)

<a id="q-14686c161db76926"></a>

## Privateer's License

Warlords keep their seats by being useful. Pirates who cross a Warlord rarely sail again.

Defeat twenty-five pirates while holding your seat.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [The Government's Offer](f_warlords.md#q-149839deb0f6a5b9)

**Tasks**

- Defeat 25 pirates

**Rewards**

- Doriki +420, Belly +24,500, +1 Training Points (your style)

<a id="q-638bc9d62e689cfe"></a>

## A Warlord's Domain

Crocodile had Alabasta, Doflamingo had Dressrosa, Hancock had Amazon Lily.

Own an island through island conquest.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Privateer's License](f_warlords.md#q-14686c161db76926)

**Tasks**

- Own 1 island at once (island conquest)

**Rewards**

- Doriki +420, Belly +50,000, +1 Training Points (your style)

<a id="q-3585e345ec73c229"></a>

## Called to Marineford

When Whitebeard came for Ace, the Government called every Warlord to the front line.

Defeat thirty pirates on Marineford.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [A Warlord's Domain](f_warlords.md#q-638bc9d62e689cfe)

**Tasks**

- Defeat 30 pirates on Marineford

**Rewards**

- Doriki +540, Belly +42,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +1 Training Points (your style)

## Shadow of the Seven

Not every rival pirate can be bought. Some have to be stopped.

Defeat three pirate players with a bounty of at least 25,000,000.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Called to Marineford](f_warlords.md#q-3585e345ec73c229)

**Tasks**

- Defeat 3 pirate players (bounty 25,000,000+)

**Rewards**

- Doriki +540, Belly +80,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +1 Training Points (your style)

## Peerless

Dracule Mihawk sits alone in a ruined castle with a blade that cuts icebergs in half.

Reach 45,000 Doriki and obtain a Supreme Grade blade while holding your seat.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Joker](f_warlords.md#q-6c5c7106e6f938f6)

**Tasks**

- Reach 45,000 Doriki
- Obtain a Supreme Grade blade

**Rewards**

- Doriki +750, Belly +200,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +2 Training Points (your style), Golden Box
